study type: Commentary on a Randomized Controlled Trial
exposure: 2-step screening protocol for gestational diabetes mellitus (50g 1-hour glucose challenge followed by 100g 3-hour oral glucose tolerance test)
1-step diagnostic testing protocol for gestational diabetes mellitus (75g 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test)
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing screening and diagnosis for gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: The randomized controlled trial reviewed concluded there was no significant difference between the 2-step and 1-step GDM screening/diagnostic protocols in their impact on population adverse short-term pregnancy outcomes.
